01 / THE KEEPSAKE

The Keepsake

$4,650 per wedding

The Keepsake includes 8 hours of coverage, two photographers, an online gallery, and 600+ edited images.

For the ceremony, the people, and the heart of the celebration.

02 / THE FULL STORY

The Full Story

$5,800 per wedding

The Full Story includes 10 hours of coverage, two photographers, an engagement session, and 800+ edited images.

A slower start, a little more dancing, and room for the in-between.

03 / THE HEIRLOOM

The Heirloom

$7,200 per wedding

The Heirloom includes 12 hours of coverage, an engagement session, a 10-inch album, and 1,000+ edited images.

The day, the details, and something you can hold in your hands.

THE OTHER PARTICULARS

Clear details.
No little surprises.

A little longer

Additional coverage is $350 per hour, subject to availability.

A little farther

The first 50 miles of travel are included. Travel beyond 50 miles is charged at $2 per mile, calculated round trip.

Taxes & fees

Sales tax is added where applicable. There is no automatic gratuity or mandatory service fee.

Making it yours

Extra coverage, albums, and engagement sessions are available as custom additions. Bespoke additions are quoted before you book.
